candidate_073.name: confidence-gated mechanism-discrimination to within-mechanism refinement acquisition arbitration
candidate_073.mechanism_hypothesis: Maintain an explicit set of competing mechanisms and all accumulated evidence. While held-out/bootstrap confidence in the current mechanism class is low, allocate experiments to parameter regions where plausible mechanisms make maximally different predictions. Once confidence crosses a calibrated threshold, change the acquisition objective from structural discrimination to local uncertainty reduction/refinement inside the surviving mechanism class. If the mechanism-disagreement signal is absent or degenerate, fall back to an uncertainty-based acquisition rather than fabricating discrimination value.

primary_evidence.source: Sanchit Kabra et al., LLM-AutoSciLab: Closed-Loop Scientific Discovery via Active Experimentation with LLMs, arXiv:2605.24043, 2026-05-21, with public release scientific-discovery/LLM-AutoSciLab.
primary_evidence.design: Closed-loop simulator-based scientific discovery across NewtonBench, ActiveSciBench-Chem and ActiveSciBench-GRN. The system keeps structured hypotheses and memory, proposes regions, fits a surrogate on all accumulated observations, and programmatically chooses experiments. The paper specifies hypothesis-disagreement acquisition in low-confidence regimes and refinement/uncertainty acquisition in high-confidence regimes; public code corroborates disagreement scoring, uncertainty fallbacks and full-history GP refitting.
primary_evidence.quantitative_result: At the paper's fixed budgets, LLM-AutoSciLab reports NewtonBench symbolic accuracy 67.60%, exact 81.50%, RMSLE 0.150; ActiveSciBench-Chem symbolic accuracy 35.09%, exact 50.88%, RMSLE 0.189; and ActiveSciBench-GRN edge F1 72.49%, exact graph 31.11%, sign accuracy 98.15%. Strong comparison points include PySR symbolic accuracy 24.07% and Bayesian Optimization 24.54% on Newton; BED 31.58% symbolic accuracy, 39.47% exact and RMSLE 0.249 on Chem; and GIES 56.27% F1/6.67% exact plus uncertainty sampling 50.10% F1/4.44% exact on GRN. Budget analysis reports the strongest active baselines need approximately 2.60-3.10x more Newton queries, 2.33-2.47x more Chem queries and 3.90-4.60x more GRN queries to match the fixed-budget system; LLM-only/code-assisted baselines require 5.20-14.40x in the reported comparisons.
primary_evidence.component_evidence: The paper's single-component ablation reports a substantial degradation across all benchmark families when hypothesis-conditioned acquisition is removed. It separately reports that diverse hypothesis generation/mechanism stability is especially important on Newton, memory on Chem, and evidence preservation/intervention selection on GRN. Exact bar values were not recovered in this invocation and are not inferred.
primary_evidence.implementation_corroboration: The public autoscilab/al/selector.py refits its GP on all historical data, samples candidates only inside the LLM-specified physical region, implements a 'disagree' acquisition that scores variance among compiled hypotheses and adds only a small uncertainty tie-break, and falls back to uncertainty/objective-aware acquisition when disagreement is unusable. The paper describes a confidence score from held-out prediction variability, with a reported confidence threshold of 0.9 governing the discrimination-to-refinement switch.
primary_evidence.interpretation: This is stronger than a fixed exploration/exploitation mixture: the controller changes the scientific objective of acquisition according to whether the current bottleneck is mechanism identification or parameter/refinement uncertainty. It provides a same-system autonomous-science example of stage-aware acquisition arbitration.
primary_evidence.limits: The three benchmark families use simulator/oracle environments rather than real laboratory acquisition with sensor failure, batch effects or physical measurement costs. The component ablation supports hypothesis-conditioned acquisition as a whole, but does not isolate the exact 0.9 confidence threshold or prove that the confidence-gated switch itself is causally superior to a fixed arbitration schedule. Performance depends on hypothesis quality, expression parsing, surrogate fidelity and the benchmark oracle. Therefore the gate-specific effect remains unisolated.

candidate_073.relation_to_existing: candidate_066 focused on pre-frozen experiments and metrics that discriminate current competing theories; candidate_070 showed an adaptive diversity-to-uncertainty schedule in bioacoustic active learning; candidate_071 separated discovery yield from coverage/generalization objectives; candidate_072 placed physical measurement admissibility ahead of acquisition scoring. candidate_073 adds an autonomous mechanism-discovery controller that changes between structural disambiguation and within-mechanism refinement. It does not yet solve the separate frontier of dynamically reallocating discovery versus coverage/generalization lanes under support drift, and it does not include a measurement-fidelity gate.
